violations.affected_code: icon: colorSelected.color == ColorSeed.values[i].color && colorSelectionMethod == ColorSelectionMethod.colorSeed ? const Icon(Icons.circle) : const Icon(Icons.radio_button_unchecked)
violations.explanation: The selected color is indicated only visually by swapping icons (filled circle vs. unchecked radio). The IconButton exposes no selected/checked state (e.g., via Semantics(selected:), isSelected, or inMutuallyExclusiveGroup), so screen reader users cannot tell which color seed is currently selected.

violations.type: Use of color as the only means of conveying information
violations.explanation: Each option is differentiated visually only by icon color; users with color vision deficiencies cannot distinguish options without the tooltip, which requires hover/long-press. No visible text label is provided.
Icons rendered in light colors such as Colors.yellow may not meet the 3:1 non-text contrast ratio against a light background, making the control and its state hard to perceive.
